2607.17082.title: Otap:Structure-Aware Optimal Transport for Evaluating Planning and Execution in Agent Trajectories
2607.17082.paper_summary: Large language model agents solve tasks by generating trajectories that interleave planning, tool calls, and intermediate results. Current evaluation metrics reduce such a trajectory to a binary success flag or compare it against a reference by exact matching. A success flag cannot distinguish a sound solution from one that succeeds by luck, and says nothing about why a failed run went wrong. Exact matching penalizes plans that are valid but reordered or decomposed differently from the reference. We reframe trajectory evaluation as a distance between the agent's execution graph and a set of valid solution graphs, and instantiate it via an unbalanced fused Gromov-Wasserstein transport problem over attributed dependency graphs. The resulting score, termed \otap{} (Optimal Transport for Agentic Planning), is a pseudo-metric that is provably invariant to dependency-preserving reorderings and has bounded sensitivity to redundant steps. Its unbalanced marginals handle missing or hallucinated steps without forcing a match, and its soft coupling accommodates variation in plan granularity. On controlled perturbations and three public benchmarks, \otap{} separates valid from invalid trajectories in a regime where semantics-only metrics score below chance. Its accuracy is highest when the dependency graph is recovered exactly, and drops only when the graph is inferred heuristically from free-text traces.
2607.17082.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理透過生成交錯規劃、工具調用和中間結果的軌跡來解決任務。當前的評估指標將這樣的軌跡簡化為二元成功標誌，或通過精確匹配與參考進行比較。成功標誌無法區分合理解決方案與僅僅依賴運氣成功的方案，也無法說明失敗執行為何出錯。精確匹配會對有效但與參考順序不同或拆解方式不同的計劃進行懲罰。我們將軌跡評估重新定義為代理執行圖與一組有效解決圖之間的距離，並通過一個不平衡的融合 Gromov-Wasserstein 運輸問題在屬性依賴圖上實現它。得到的分數稱為 \otap{}（代理規劃的最優運輸），是一種伪度量，證明對於保持依賴關係的重新排序是不變的，並且對冗餘步驟的敏感性是有界的。其不平衡邊際處理缺失或幻覺的步驟，而無需強制匹配，並且其柔性耦合適應計劃粒度的變化。在受控擾動和三個公共基準上，\otap{} 在語義僅指標得分低於機會的範疇中，能夠區分有效和無效的軌跡。當依賴圖被精確恢復時，其準確性最高，只有在圖從自由文本痕跡中以啟發式推斷時才會下降。
